ostrzezenia.tekst: Raw elderberries may contain elevated levels of toxic compounds, so always cook elderberries before eating them. [T:SLO-061]
Elder stems and leaves contain higher levels of toxins, so remove them before processing. [T:SLO-062]

Oregon State University Extension says European elderberries are difficult to tell apart from American elderberries, and the pH of American elderberries is not consistently below 4.6, so for canning follow recommended recipes for American elderberries with high sugar ratios. [T:SLO-064]
